notes: Daily rhythm of the campaign. Every finished duel spends one third of the school day (AM -> PM -> Night -> next morning). A new day always starts in the player's room in their current dorm, so promotion/demotion changes where the player wakes up. Story-event duels never change the date in the middle of a scene: a duel fought at Night inside an event rolls the calendar over when that event (and any same-night follow-up) ends.

duel_time.untimed_note: Syrus's orientation practice duel, puzzle-scenario duels and exam sections keep their own clock.

PM.title: AFTERNOON
PM.body: The duel took the morning. It is now {date}.

Night.title: EVENING
Night.body: The sun sets on the island while you pack up your deck. It is now {date}.

next_day.title: LIGHTS OUT
next_day.body: That was the last duel of the day. Time to head back to the dorm.

deferred.title: LATE NIGHT
deferred.body: It is getting late. The day ends once this is over.

morning.dorm_note: The room follows profile.dorm: Slifer Red -> slifer, Ra Yellow -> ra, Obelisk Blue and the Society of Light (white Obelisk dorm) -> obelisk.
